I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm the 23 May deadline: I found no Thornbury Cloth Co. files in the share, and nothing in #central-team mentions an order-form deadline.

I also pointed out that 23 May 2026 has already passed (today is 14 October 2026). If the deadline is real, it may mean May 2027, though that's a guess. I suggested she get the date and year confirmed in writing by her Thornbury contact before anyone plans around it.

Nothing else was posted, sent or recorded. A date like this isn't a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
